# oneprovider_vm_project (Data Source)

Fetches a VM project by its name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    oneprovider = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/MadJlzz/oneprovider"
    }
  }
}

provider "oneprovider" {}

data "oneprovider_vm_project" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}

output "project_id" {
  value = data.oneprovider_vm_project.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact project name. If multiple projects share this name, the first match returned by the API is used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project UUID to use in the project attribute of a VM instance.
